subject: Feature enablement kickoff — live-parser, tool-routing & schema checkpoints
messages:
From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@carebridge.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@carebridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff request — live parser & tool-routing for notes (sprint0)

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move into a Sprint0 kickoff to validate live JSON outputs and the function/tool calling path for CareBridge’s clinician notes pipeline. High-level asks from our side: 

- Streaming: confirm how partial tokens / interim JSON objects are emitted (we need chunked validity for our consumer).
- Structured outputs: agree on the top-level schema and sign-off process (we expect an initial schema freeze).
- Tool-calls: map Redwood tool-calls to our downstream parsers (e.g., enrich -> med-entity-extract, send-to-EHR).
- Acceptance: define runtime tests & pass/fail criteria (latency SLO, malformed-object tolerance).

Can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) and a first-pass schema we can iterate on? Also looping in Contracts because we’ll likely need a short SOW amendment for the canary phase.

Proposed kickoff window: Thu 12/2 or Fri 12/3 (PST). What works for you?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Romero
Director, Product
CareBridge

Attachments: none in this message
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@carebridge.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 17:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — live parser & tool-routing for notes (sprint0)

Hi Alex — great to hear you’re ready to start. Thanks for laying out the asks. I’ve sketched a short Sprint0 MAP and a schema stub to accelerate alignment. Quick notes up front:

- Streaming behavior: Redwood will emit partial chunks with syntactic boundaries at the top-level object (we’ll attach a small harness to assert chunk-valid JSON using the streaming schema).
- Schema flow: we propose a v0 schema (attached) for sign-off, followed by two iterations before freeze.
- Tool mapping: we’ll propose a canonical mapping doc during the kickoff; final mapping will be a shared XLSX we can both edit.
- Acceptance: suggest three test gates — schema validation, end-to-end sample throughput (50/min), canary correctness at 10% traffic.

I’m available Thu 12/2 10–12 PST or Fri 12/3 09–11 PST. I’ve attached: sprint0-map.pdf (MAP overview) and schema-stub-v0.json (first-pass).

Key immediate ask for CareBridge: who will own the schema sign-off on your side (name/email)? Also confirm whether your EHR ingest requires single JSON per note or can accept multi-part streaming reassembly — we’ll adapt our tooling accordingly.

If that looks good I’ll loop in our CS engineering lead to own the test harness.

—
Priyom Das
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: sprint0-map.pdf (application/pdf), schema-stub-v0.json (application/json)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 18:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — live parser & tool-routing for notes (sprint0)

Priyom / Irene — I can own schema validation and runtime acceptance criteria. I’ll prepare: 

- a set of ~25 canonical test payloads (edge cases + typical notes) and bundle as test-payloads.zip;
- a short runner that validates streaming chunk recomposition against schema-stub-v0.json;
- an acceptance checklist (latency target: p95 < 350ms for generated tokens post-priming; tolerance: max 0.5% malformed objects over 24h).

Proposed timeline (internal): schema freeze candidate Dec 3 EOD, test harness ready Dec 6, integration test run Dec 8–9. If successful, we’ll propose a canary on Dec 10 with 10% traffic.

I’ll also flag any schema gaps back to CareBridge during kickoff.

—Monica
Monica Patel
CS Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: test-payloads.zip (archive)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 19:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff request — live parser & tool-routing for notes (sprint0)

Thanks all — I’ll take ownership of tool-call orchestration and the staging plan. Quick decisions I want to confirm at kickoff:

1) Tool mapping artifact: I’ll create the shared tool-mapping.xlsx with columns: redwood_tool, expected_payload, egress_type, retry_policy, downstream_topic.
2) Canary plan: run a canary against our dedicated variant with 10% traffic (decoupled KV cache) — if errors < 0.5% and no schema regressions we can widen to 50% on Dec 13.
3) Ops hooks: we’ll enable token-level tracing and a lightweight replay log for first 72h of canary.

I’ve attached an initial draft tool-mapping.xlsx to seed the kickoff.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachments: tool-mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Alex — thanks for the quick start. Confirming next steps and who’s owning what so we have a single source of truth going into the kickoff.

Sprint0 MAP (summary & dates):
- Dec 2–3: Kickoff & alignment (schema first pass, tool-call mapping, test criteria) — meeting to confirm Dec 2 10:00 PST (I’ll send a calendar invite).
- Dec 3 (EOD): schema freeze candidate (CareBridge sign-off owner: Alex Romero).
- Dec 6: test harness + canonical payloads delivered (Monica).
- Dec 8–9: integration smoke tests (Redwood + CareBridge).
- Dec 10: 10% traffic canary (Irene ops + Monica validation).
- Dec 13: widen to 50% if canary metrics are green.
- Dec 17: target go-live for production routing (subject to success gates).

Action items assigned: 
- CareBridge: confirm schema sign-off owner (Alex) and confirm EHR ingest mode (single JSON vs streaming reassembly).
- Redwood: deliver test-payloads.zip (Monica), tool-mapping.xlsx draft (Irene), MAP + schema-stub-v0.json (me).
- Contracts: please review SOW amendment linked below and advise on expedited sign-off path.

Attached: sprint0-map.pdf, schema-stub-v0.json, test-payloads.zip, tool-mapping.xlsx, SOW_CareBridge_RevA.pdf
